name: Ammann-Beenker
desc: An eightfold aperiodic quasicrystal of silver-ratio squares and 45-degree rhombi grown by 4D cut-and-project, slowly rotating beneath a luminous highlight that travels the Ammann-bar grid, rendered as jewel-toned tiles, Escher stained glass, neon lattice, cyan blueprint, or austere sumi ink.

density.doc: tile fineness (higher = smaller, more numerous tiles). Rebuilds.

scale.doc: tile zoom (higher = larger tiles / fewer visible). Rebuilds.

energy.doc: brightness of the traveling Ammann-bar highlight

speed.doc: rotation + highlight-sweep rate (0 still slowly drifts)

glow.doc: width of the luminous highlight band along the bars
